summary: VLibras API bug fix verification complete. All tests pass. The broken API (VLibras.Widget.sendMessage) has been replaced with the correct API (plugin.player.translate) in both player.js and html_exporter.py. Fixed an additional bug in html_exporter.py where vlibras_block variable was not passed to generate_html_template function.
critical_code_review_comments: VLibras API fix verified: player.js (Lines 134-185) and html_exporter.py (Lines 1360-1408) now use correct window.plugin.player.translate API
Broken API (VLibras.Widget.sendMessage) confirmed NOT present in either file
translateWithVLibras function exists in both files with proper fallback logic (clicks access button if plugin not initialized)
Fixed additional bug: html_exporter.py generate_html_template function now accepts enable_vlibras parameter and defines vlibras_block locally
context_for_next_testing_agent: VLibras integration uses window.plugin.player.translate API to send text for LIBRAS translation. The translateWithVLibras function handles both cases: 1) plugin already initialized - translates directly, 2) plugin not yet initialized - clicks access button to open VLibras widget and waits for plugin to init before translating.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: Previous implementation used non-existent API window.VLibras.Widget.sendMessage. Fix: Replaced with correct internal VLibras plugin API window.plugin.player.translate(text). Additional bug found during testing: vlibras_block variable was defined in generate_standalone_html but not passed to generate_html_template, causing NameError. Fixed by adding enable_vlibras parameter and defining vlibras_block inside generate_html_template.
